text: Now when the dung beetle is crushed mid-reply, the error is caught and the controller is aborted, signaling generateText to stop itself. As Promise doesn't natively support cancellation, we must do this verbose wiring ourselves. Furthermore, your dependencies won't always work with abort signals, or do so uniformly. Most production TypeScript backends simply ignore this problem, tolerating, perhaps unwittingly, the monetary and computational costs of leaking everything everywhere, all of the time.
